title: "type:decision: {scope} - {short description}"
labels: ["type:decision", "status:needs-triage", "priority:normal"]

file_type: issue-template
---

<!--
Use this template to record a decision so the reasoning is easy to find later.
Questions and support requests belong in GitHub Discussions, not issues.
If the decision changes files, make those changes on a docs/ branch.
-->

## Summary

<!--
What needs deciding, and by when?
-->

## Context

<!--
What is the current situation? Which constraints, standards or deadlines apply?
Link the evidence (issues, PRs, specs, reports, metrics).
-->

## Options Considered

<!--
List at least two options, including "do nothing" where relevant.
For each option: pros, cons and cost.
-->

## Decision

<!--
State the decision, who decided (for governance decisions, @ashley) and the date.
Leave blank until the decision is made.
-->

## Consequences

<!--
What becomes easier or harder? What follow-up work, migrations or documentation are needed?
-->

## Linked Work

<!--
Link implementation issues, the docs/ PR, any decision-record file, and any decisions this supersedes.

Related epic: {related_epic}
Related issues: {related_issues}
Related pull requests: {related_pull_requests}
-->

---

## Definition of Ready (DoR)

- [ ] Decision needed is clearly stated
- [ ] Context and constraints described, with evidence linked
- [ ] At least two options listed
- [ ] Decider identified

## Definition of Done (DoD)

- [ ] Decision recorded with decider and date
- [ ] Consequences and follow-up work captured as linked issues
- [ ] Documentation updated through a `docs/` PR where files change
- [ ] Linked issue(s) updated with latest status and closed after merge
- [ ] The related epic is not closed; it is updated with a comment reflecting the closed issue

---
